content: We need to identify SMILES of an organic sample given no data yet. We need to use tools to get spectra etc. The task description doesn't provide any experimental data. Perhaps the environment has a sample "at hand" with spectra accessible via tools. So we should start by measuring mass spectrometry to get molecular weight, then maybe carbon NMR, proton NMR, IR, etc. Use minimal experiments. Usually start with mass spec to get formula. Let's call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
